steps.action: Install this package in its own environment outside every Git checkout.
Create dedicated private profile, broker control and actor state paths for one character.
Start broker, connect and complete protected local login. Use --secret --stdin for the password; verify character, then release human control.
Read status; claim only an available dedicated session. Inspect any uncertain result.
Read original text, color spans, receipt and supplementary scene. Require a complete fresh observation before authoring a decision.
Choose one command and a new stable decision ID. Copy exact next_decision fields without refreshing them.
Invoke one send, or explicitly choose fixed retreat with exact enemy_status and optional AFK opt-in.
Inspect delivery and new observations. Never replay an uncertain command or infer game completion from a transport receipt.
Release confirmed control when handing back; keep other actors' runtime state separate.
